conviction_note: Q3 revenue (EUR 87.5m) and a raised FY guide (EUR 323-333m, adj. EBIT margin 18.5-19.5%) were already pre-released by ad-hoc on 2026-10-07. That leaves the Q3 EBIT, order intake, backlog and free cash flow as the new lines, and none of them is pre-sourceable. The one sourced lean is that the company published no Q3 order release after making one for June (>EUR 100m, 29 Jul), so Q3 intake probably normalises from H1's 2.2x book-to-bill. The Boxer/Arminius slip at Rheinmetall (a direct counterparty programme) was already priced and reversed on 5-9 Nov. abs_move stays well above the 3% pre-released base because the last full report (13 Aug, revenue also pre-released) moved +9.9% on the order-intake line and realised vol is 47.5%. p_up 45 because this name sold its October guidance raise (+1.4%, then -2.1% and -2.4%). The sum of findings (-1.4) and the scaled number (-0.6) agree in sign; the scaled number is smaller because the sign lean rests on an absence, not a document.

session_check: bmo. This is precedent, not a timestamp for this release: the last scheduled full report (H1, 13 Aug 2026) went out at 07:30 CET/CEST (https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/vincorion-grows-revenue-and-earnings/cafc336f-7403-4635-9a9a-2ee6a5654a38_en). The date 11 Nov comes from the issuer's own ad-hoc of 2026-10-07 ('VINCORION wird seine Ergebnisse für die ersten neun Monate am 11. November 2026 veröffentlichen'). One aggregator says 10 Nov, but EQS shows no Vincorion release on 10 Nov as of 15:00 UTC. The unscheduled ad-hoc of 7 Oct landed at 15:45 CEST, so an intraday release is not impossible.
positioning_check: Bundesanzeiger Netto-Leerverkaufspositionen as of 2026-11-09: no disclosed net short of 0.5% or more (covered: true, anchor_covered: false). That is the truncation floor, not evidence that nobody is short. Change 0.0; building or covering is not known. Ownership is the real positioning fact: STAR Capital holds 48.63% (Stimmrechtsmitteilung of 24 Apr 2026, https://www.eqs-news.com/news/voting-rights/star-capital-partnership-llp-london-grosbritannien/ca26d6d1-b6f4-4843-8026-080b3276d5c3_de), and its 180-day lock-up from the 20 Mar 2026 listing has expired with no disposal notified. That makes it a standing supply overhang. Caisse des Dépôts went to 3.03% on 22 Sep.

findings.finding: No Q3 order announcement exists, while the company did publish one for June (>EUR 100m). Q3 order intake is therefore likely to normalise well below Q1 (EUR 149.4m) and Q2 (EUR 180.8m), cutting book-to-bill from H1's 2.2x. That is the line that carried the +9.9% on the last full report.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 13 Aug 2026 H1 report (revenue already pre-released 10 Jul): Q2 order intake EUR 180.8m vs 33.9m and the stock closed +9.9% (19.30 -> 21.21), then +4.9% the next day (Yahoo tape; goldesel: 'Aktie reagiert deutlich positiv'). 7 May Q1 report with order intake ~4x: intraday all-time high of 23.78, then profit-taking to 22.
findings.why_not_priced: Order intake is not in the pre-release, and no consensus for it can be sourced. The October pre-release headlines were all about revenue. If the market had priced a step-down in intake, the 9-Nov rebound (+5.8%) and the recovery from the Rheinmetall-day drop would not have taken the stock back to its pre-drop level of 18.34-18.40. Caveat: this is an inference from absence. Defence orders are lumpy and not always announced, which is why the range is wide and the size small.
findings.independence: The company's own 29 Jul release shows it publicises large monthly intake (https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/vincorion-records-more-than-eur-100-million-in-order-intake-in-june-2026/e5205123-dc41-4bfd-a5a5-3f14fb8b4278_en). The EQS issuer search shows no order item from Jul to Nov. Both are company channels, so this is not truly independent.

findings.finding: Rheinmetall cut its FY2026 guide on 5 Nov because the Bundeswehr's Boxer modernisation (Arminius) can only be ordered next year. Vincorion holds a KNDS framework for Boxer onboard generators, so its 2027 order phasing commentary is exposed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the counterparty news itself: 5 Nov -6.6% (Rheinmetall -16.1%), then +2.3% and +5.8% on 6 and 9 Nov. Fully retraced to 18.40, against an 18.34 close on 4 Nov.
findings.original_quote: "Verzögerungen im Projekt Arminius der Bundeswehr" ... "erst im kommenden Jahr beauftragt werden kann" (delays in the Bundeswehr's Arminius project ... can only be awarded next year); Börsen-Zeitung: "Verzögerungen im Programm für den Transportpanzer 'Boxer'"
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The stock fell 6.6% on the day and then fully recovered, so the market judged the exposure small. It only matters if management quantifies a 2027 order slip on the call. Macro-to-company transmission is unconfirmed by Vincorion itself, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Vincorion's own Boxer generator framework with KNDS (2024-04-04, https://vincorion.com/en/vincorion-awarded-major-contract-for-generators-for-the-boxer-wheeled-tank/); Börsen-Zeitung 2026-11-05 (https://www.boersen-zeitung.de/unternehmen-branchen/verzoegerung-beim-projekt-arminius-zwingt-rheinmetall-kurs-in-die-knie)

findings.finding: The raised FY adj. EBIT margin guide (18.5-19.5%, midpoint 19.0% on EUR 328m, about EUR 62m) against H1 adj. EBIT of EUR 28.4m (18.9%) implies an H2 margin of about 19.1%. Q3 EBIT should therefore print at or slightly above H1's margin, inside the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 margin fell to 18.0% from 19.4% and the stock sold off from its high on the day (dpa-AFX, 7 May). Q2 margin was 19.7%, down from 21.1%, within a +9.9% day driven by orders.
findings.original_quote: "Zudem rechnet der Vorstand nun mit einer höheren bereinigten EBIT-Marge von 18,5 % bis 19,5 % für das Geschäftsjahr 2026 (ursprünglich 18,0 % bis 19,0 %)." (The board now also expects a higher adjusted EBIT margin of 18.5% to 19.5% for FY2026, originally 18.0% to 19.0%.)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is arithmetic on a public guide, and the stock sold the guide raise (-2.1% and -2.4% on 8-9 Oct). The only residual is a Q3 margin above 20%, which the guide does not rule out.
findings.independence: H1 figures from the company's 13 Aug release (https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/vincorion-grows-revenue-and-earnings/cafc336f-7403-4635-9a9a-2ee6a5654a38_en)

findings.finding: The guide implies Q4 revenue of EUR 85.3-95.3m, about +19% to +33% on Q4 2025 (about EUR 72m), against +41% YTD. The company itself calls Q3 'exceptionally strong in a traditionally weaker summer season', which reads as timing, so the Q4/2027 growth framing on the call may disappoint.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance raise on 7 Oct: +1.4% that day (released 15:45), then -2.1% and -2.4%. This name sold its raise.

findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The implied Q4 is public arithmetic (goldesel computed the 85.3-95.3m on 7 Oct), so only management's framing on the call is new.

baseline_tension: Mild agreement. The lean is about zero (-0.05) and the 20-day run-up is +1.0%, so the slight negative lean from the order-intake absence neither fights nor restates the positioning. There is no disclosed short to squeeze, and the overhang that exists (STAR Capital's 48.6%) argues against upside follow-through rather than for a squeeze.
language_note: The German ad-hoc text carried the company's own explanation that Q3 was 'außergewöhnlich stark ... in einer traditionell schwächeren Sommersaison', a timing hint that the English wire summaries dropped.

Börsen-Zeitung (German) tied Rheinmetall's 5 Nov cut explicitly to the Boxer programme ('Transportpanzer Boxer'). That is the link to Vincorion's Boxer generator framework; the English release summary named only 'Arminius'.
The German STAR Capital Stimmrechtsmitteilung gave the exact post-IPO stake (48.63%), which defines the lock-up overhang; English coverage cites a rounded ~47.5%.

German retail and aggregator sites (boerse-express, finanztrends, trading-treff) carried the analyst roster and targets (Berenberg, JPM, DB, BNP, Oddo), but mostly as AI-generated copy with inconsistent dates, so none of it is load-bearing.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the margin-implied-by-guide finding cut from +0.3 to +0.1, and the implied-Q4-deceleration finding from -0.2 to -0.1. Both are arithmetic on the public 7 Oct guide.

'Too small about the move' and 'understatement is the systematic error': abs_move_pct raised from 5.5 to 6.0, given the +9.9% on the last pre-released-revenue report day and 47.5% realised vol. p_up left at 45 (the beats-sold veto acts on p_up, not on size). The order-intake finding's low end widened to -5.
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': free cash flow added explicitly as an unknown new line. No sourced direction, so no finding.
